newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MATARRESE SAYS SACCHI SAVED MALDINI'S JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATARRESE SAYS SACCHI SAVED MALDINI'S JOB.

text.p: Former Italian soccer boss Antonio Matarrese said he had wanted to sack current national coach Cesare Maldini when he was in charge of Italy's under-21 team but was persuaded not to by Arrigo Sacchi.

Matarrese, who was ousted as federation president last year shortly before Sacchi quit as Italy coach and was replaced by Maldini, told RAI television on Friday night that he had been exasperated by reported comments by Maldini.
"I had decided to dismiss Cesare Maldini when he was under-21 coach but Arrigo Sacchi convinced me not to," he said.
Maldini went on to win three European under-21 titles and his national team has yet to concede a goal under him, leading World Cup qualifying group two ahead of England.
His present popularity far exceeds that of Sacchi, now presiding over an off-form AC Milan and slammed by many despite taking Italy to the 1994 World Cup final.
